items.quote: Seriously one of the BEST AC companies around in the south Florida area. Max has an incredible knowledge of all AC units, and stands out among his competitors because he is genuine and honest. We got a variety of quotes and were lied to by others on unnecessary repairs. He gave me a very fair price and explained all the options we had.

After a summer from hell with my AC, Max and his team came to the rescue, quickly assessed the issues and resolved promptly. Prior to this, we had at least 3 other companies come to my home over 8 times with no resolution. In what I assume is a very competitive industry in Miami, integrity is the difference maker and Max and his team have it and they do a great job!

I highly recommend this company. From the moment I made my appointment till the job was complete they have been prompt and professional. They always pick up the phone or respond quickly to any calls. The tech Max was quick and very polite. He completed the job fast and it was done properly.

The Home Pros team did a great job installing my new AC and all new ductwork. Their pricing was reasonable and their service was superb. I had a room in my home that was always warm and now it's ice cold in there, so two thumbs up!
